description: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, across different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, marked at intervals of 2.5. For PHEME, the bars are colored as follows: "Ours" is dark red with a value of 89.84, "w/o comments" is red with a value of 86.82, "w/o text" is yellow with a value of 80.10, "w/o select" is light blue with a value of 88.80, "w/o emotion" is blue with a value of 87.34, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue with a value of 87.17. For PolitiFact, the bars have the same color scheme, with values of 90.57, 85.85, 83.02, 89.62, 84.91, and 87.74, respectively. The bars are grouped by dataset, with PHEME on the left and PolitiFact on the right, and are not sorted in any particular order within each group. No bars are visually emphasized.
